title: Pro-étale coefficient rings
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, an algebraic closure $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ with its extending valuation topology, and a finite intermediate extension $\mathbf Q_\ell\subseteq E\subseteq\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$. Put $\mathcal O_E=\{x\in E:|x|\leq1\}$, with the subspace topology. Let $X$ be any scheme and $T\in\{\mathcal O_E,E,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell\}$.

Use the coefficient presheaves $\underline T$ of [pur713-def-continuous-rings] and [pur713-def-qbar-ring]. They are sheaves of commutative rings, hence commutative ring objects of $\mathsf{Sh}(*_{\mathrm{pro\acute et}},\mathsf{Ab})$, by [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring] for $T=\mathcal O_E,E$ and [sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed] for $T=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$. In the last case the sections on a profinite set $S$ are continuous maps whose image is contained in some finite subextension of $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell/\mathbf Q_\ell$, with the finite subextension allowed to depend on the section.

The coefficient ring on the small pro-étale site $X_{\mathrm{pro\acute et}}$ is
$$
\mathcal R_{X,T}:=p_X^*\underline T,
$$
where $p_X^*$ is the inverse-image functor of [sk-def-sfb-pullback-from-point]. Its commutative ring-object structure is the transported structure of [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]: writing $\mu_T$ and $\eta_T$ for the multiplication and unit of $\underline T$, its multiplication and unit are
$$
p_X^*\underline T\otimes p_X^*\underline T\xrightarrow{\sim}p_X^*(\underline T\otimes\underline T)\xrightarrow{p_X^*\mu_T}p_X^*\underline T,
\qquad
\mathbf Z\xrightarrow{\sim}p_X^*\mathbf Z\xrightarrow{p_X^*\eta_T}p_X^*\underline T.
$$
In the notation $\Lambda_X$ of [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients], this is $\Lambda_X$ for $\Lambda=\underline T$. No identification of its value on a pro-étale $U$ with $C(|U|,T)$ is part of this definition or used here.

proof.text: For $T=\mathcal O_E$ or $E$, [pur713-def-continuous-rings] specifies exactly the continuous-map presheaf with pointwise operations and precomposition restrictions. These are the two corresponding coefficient rings of [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], whose statement supplies their sheaf property and commutative ring-object structure. For $T=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, [pur713-def-qbar-ring] instead restricts to continuous maps with image in a finite subextension. Its section condition, restrictions and pointwise operations agree exactly with [sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed], whose statement supplies the sheaf property without sheafification and the commutative ring-object structure. Thus in all three cases the specified $\underline T$ is an object in the domain of $p_X^*$; the algebraic-closure case has not been replaced by all continuous maps.

source.place: the coefficient inputs in the sentence after the displayed definition; compared with the two cited coefficient definitions

proof.text: Part 4 of [sk-def-sfb-pullback-from-point] defines $p_X^*=\pi_X^*\circ p^*$ for every scheme $X$, with codomain abelian sheaves on its small pro-étale site, and asserts that it is strong monoidal and braided. Define the underlying object $\mathcal R_{X,T}$ to be $p_X^*\underline T$. Specialize [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients] to the commutative ring object $\Lambda=\underline T$ obtained in step 1. Its displayed unit and multiplication are exactly the two composites specified here, and its final clause gives commutativity of this transported ring object. This is precisely its notation $\Lambda_X$ at $\Lambda=\underline T$. The construction uses the inverse image as a functor on sheaves, so it neither requires nor supplies a formula $\mathcal R_{X,T}(U)=C(|U|,T)$.

lean.statement:
noncomputable def coefficientRing (X : Scheme.{u})
    (Λ : Mon (Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})) :
    Mon (Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
lean.note: Existing canonical construction, specialized to Λ = Mon.mk (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E), Mon.mk (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E), and Mon.mk (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ), with E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ and [Fact ℓ.Prime]. Its underlying object is p_X^* underline T; the unit and multiplication are definitionally the two prescribed composites via Functor.monObjObj. The three commutativity witnesses are isCommMonObj_condensedRingObj applied to those exact inputs. The E and Qbar specializations are also definitionally the published padicSubfieldRingObj X ℓ E and padicAlgClRingObj X ℓ. The Qbar input retains finite-subextension-valued sections. The branch label denotes the published WeilConjectures framework, read with scompile.py --source. No new definition or section formula is introduced; the report gives the complete parameter and dependency mapping.
